try: Read the choices put to Benjamin
how:
1. Open Benjamin Han’s project › "Design" (it opens on "Choices")
2. Press "By room", then "By milestone"
3. Read each card’s band, its options and the line under them
expect: The title line holds the chips Choices · Floor plan · Designs, Choices lit. Paint colours: "Waiting for Benjamin — shared … by Germaine.", options Sage Whisper ("+S$240 + GST"), Warm White and Soft Greige ("No change"), "Choose with Benjamin". Kitchen countertop: "Benjamin chose Calacatta quartz on … — The Calacatta, please…", the pick ringed, "+S$1,308.00 on the contract (S$1,200.00 + GST)" with "Open VO-1" (chapter 20), and in place of Change the pick "Carpentry fabrication has started — the pick stays".
in10: Different from 1.0: the pick is kept by option, with its price

try: Pick for Benjamin after a call, then change the pick
how:
1. On "Paint colours" press "Choose with Benjamin"; pick Warm White, keep "How it was chosen", press "Save the pick"
2. Press "Change the pick", pick Sage Whisper, press "Save the pick"
3. Read the card
expect: The window says "A pick made with Benjamin off the portal — on a call, on site. It reads as theirs."; "How it was chosen" is filled with "Chosen with the client on a call". "Chosen with Benjamin — Warm White · Painting no longer waits on Benjamin", then "The pick is now Sage Whisper"; the line reads "+S$261.60 on the contract (S$240.00 + GST)" and offers "Draft a variation order".
in10: Different from 1.0: picks change until the work starts

try: Put a choice to Sophia
how:
1. Open Sophia’s project › "Design" (it opens on "Choices"), press "Add a choice"
2. "What the client chooses" Kitchen backsplash · "Room or area" Kitchen · "Milestone" Masonry & tiling · "Needed by" two weeks from today · press "Add choice"
expect: Empty first: "No choices yet" with "Add a choice". The window says "It starts as a draft — add the options, then share it with Sophia."; under Milestone, "The pick can change until it starts". Then "Choice added — now add its options"; the band reads "Draft — add the options, then share it with Sophia."
in10: Different from 1.0: a choice is its own record

try: Give Sophia two options and share them
how:
1. Press "Add an option" › "From Materials", pick any material, press "Add option"
2. "Add an option" › "Upload a picture": drop the picture below · "Name" Matt white subway tile · "Price against the quote" Adds · "It adds (S$)" 300 · "Add option"
3. Press "Share with Sophia"
expect: Each option lands as a square with its name, price ("No change" · "+S$300 + GST") and source; the upload is "Kept in the lead’s Files › Choices". "Shared — Sophia can choose on the portal · Masonry & tiling waits on Sophia for it" with Undo (leave it); the band reads "Waiting for Sophia — shared just now by Dane."
in10: Different from 1.0: options from Materials, the Price book, a render or a photo

try: Choose on the portal as Sophia
how:
1. In the private window "Sign out", sign in with 9765 4321 and any six digits
2. Open "Choices", tap Matt white subway tile
3. Type With the grey grout, please in "A note for your designer", press "Confirm Matt white subway tile"
expect: "Choices" — "One choice waits for you. Pick the one you like, then confirm." The option reads "Adds S$327.00"; the tap rings it: "Matt white subway tile adds S$327.00 (S$300.00 + GST) to your contract. Your designer sends you the change to confirm." Then "Thank you — Demo Studio has your choice: Matt white subway tile" and "You chose Matt white subway tile on …", with "Your note: “With the grey grout, please”".
in10: Different from 1.0: the client can see, and change, what was picked

try: See Sophia’s pick arrive
how:
1. In your window reload Sophia’s "Design" › "Choices"
2. Open "Money" and read "Needs you"
3. Open "Files & notes" › "Activity"
expect: The band reads "Sophia chose Matt white subway tile … — With the grey grout, please"; the line "+S$327.00 on the contract (S$300.00 + GST)" offers "Open VO-2" — her pick drafted it. Money’s "Needs you" has "Sophia chose Matt white subway tile" with "Send VO-2". Activity files a small card under the pick’s line: the option’s square, "Kitchen backsplash · Matt white subway tile", the same price line, her note and "Masonry & tiling no longer waits on the client".
in10: Different from 1.0: a card in Activity, not a PDF receipt

try: Try to finish a job early as the designer
how:
1. "Demo Studio" block › "View as" › "Michelle"
2. Open Ryan D’Souza’s project, press "Stage: In progress" › "Completed"
3. Read the checklist, then press "Cancel"
expect: "Complete handover" lists Every milestone is done · Ryan has confirmed “Handover & defect check” · Nothing is outstanding on money · No update waits for review · Compliance’s Handover items are done · No ticket waits on the studio. Each open row says why, with "Defer" and a fix in place ("Remind", "Mark “Monitor 12-month defects…” done") or a door (Open the schedule · Open Money · Open Compliance). Michelle’s button reads "Ask an Owner or an Admin" — she cannot complete it.
in10: Different from 1.0: one ending, drawn from the records

try: Complete it anyway as the owner
how:
1. "View as" › "Dane"; on Ryan’s project "Stage: In progress" › "Completed"
2. "Why complete it with items open?" Ryan moved in early; defects agreed on site
3. Leave "Tell Ryan it’s handed over" ticked, press "Complete anyway" — a WhatsApp tab opens: close it, do not send
4. Let the message go — do not press its "Undo"
expect: "Executive Condo — Ryan D’Souza is completed" with Undo. The header reads "Stage: Completed" and a bar under the tabs says "Completed on … by Dane. … items were still open: “Ryan moved in early; defects agreed on site”. Its schedule, choices and agreed money are read-only until you reopen it…" with "Reopen". Under Open projects it is gone.
in10: Different from 1.0: open items stay on the record

try: Check a completed project stays as it was
how:
1. Open Ryan’s "Schedule" and click a bar
2. Open "Money" and press "New"
3. On the Mid-Project row open ⋮ and read "Change the amount"
expect: The schedule has no "Add milestone"; the panel reads "This project is completed — reopen it to change its schedule". Money’s "New" has no "Bill Ryan" group (no "Variation order"), only Costs; "Change the amount" is greyed: "This project is completed — reopen it to change its money".
in10: Different from 1.0: closed means closed, except money owed

try: Reopen the project
how:
1. In the bar press "Reopen"
2. "Why is it reopened?" The plumber is back for the pressure test · press "Reopen"
3. Open "Files & notes" › "Activity"
expect: The window "Reopen project" says "It goes back to In progress; its schedule, choices and money open again. The reason stays in Activity." Then "Executive Condo — Ryan D’Souza is in progress again"; Activity keeps both lines, with their reasons.
in10: Different from 1.0: a project can come back

try: Ask for an owner’s review of every handover
how:
1. "Settings" › "Projects" › "What waits for an Owner or an Admin": switch "Handover needs an owner’s review" on
2. "Projects" › the "Open projects" pill › "Completed" › "BTO 4-Room — Shalini Menon"
3. In the bar press "Reopen", reason Re-check before the warranty starts, press "Reopen"
expect: "A Designer’s or a Manager’s handover now waits for an Owner or an Admin" (leave its Undo); the Stages and handover card only points to that switch. Shalini’s project ("Completed on … by Sarah") goes back to In progress; with every milestone done, its filled button reads "Complete handover".
in10: Different from 1.0: the owner’s review is a setting

try: Ask for the handover as her designer
how:
1. "View as" › "Sarah"
2. On Shalini’s project press "Complete handover"
3. Read the checklist, press "Ask for review"
expect: Every row is ticked — "Compliance’s Handover items are done" and "No ticket waits on the studio" too; the window says an Owner or an Admin reviews it first, and its button reads "Ask for review". "Handover sent for review — an Owner or an Admin approves it"; a bar on every tab reads "You asked to complete the handover…" with "Waiting for an Owner or an Admin" and "Take it back".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Send the handover back
how:
1. "View as" › "Dane"; open Shalini’s project
2. In the bar press "Send back"
3. "What does the handover still need?" Add the warranty card to Files · press "Send back"
expect: Dane’s bar shows "Send back" and "Review", and his filled button reads "Review the handover". "Handover sent back"; the bar now reads "Handover sent back by Dane … — “Add the warranty card to Files”." (Sarah’s own bar adds "Ask again when it’s ready.")
in10: New in 2.0

try: Approve the handover
how:
1. "View as" › "Sarah"; press "Complete handover", then "Ask for review"
2. "View as" › "Dane"; press "Review the handover", untick "Tell Shalini it’s handed over", press "Approve" (leave the message’s Undo)
3. "Settings" › "Projects" › "What waits for an Owner or an Admin": switch "Handover needs an owner’s review" off
expect: The review window is titled "Review the handover" with Send back · Cancel · Approve. "BTO 4-Room — Shalini Menon is completed" with Undo; the header reads "Stage: Completed" again. The switch answers "The project’s team now completes its own handover".
in10: New in 2.0

try: Delete Sophia’s project and bring it back
how:
1. On Sophia’s project ⋮ › "Delete", read the window, press "Delete" (leave the Undo)
2. Open her lead and point at the filled button
3. "Projects" › ⋮ › "Deleted Projects"; on her row press "Restore", close the sheet
expect: The window says her lead stays Won and its page offers Make the project again. Her lead’s button reads "Make the project again" ("P-2026-… is in Deleted Projects") — do not press it. "Deleted Projects" lists Project · Client · Stage · Deleted · Deleted by, with Tan Wei Ling’s project and hers; "Project restored" and "Open project" is back on her lead.

try: Read the projects’ settings
how:
1. "Settings" › "Projects"
2. Read the two lines under the title, then the cards from top to bottom
expect: The lines point to "Roles & access › Who sees leads" and to "Finance" for invoices and payments. Cards: What waits for an Owner or an Admin ("Updates need review before the client sees them" and "Invoices need approval before they’re sent" on, … "Handover needs an owner’s review") · Project numbers ("Next project: P-2026-…") · Stages and handover · Schedule · Ticket categories · Workload · Compliance.
in10: Different from 1.0: one module instead of scattered screens

try: See who may do what on a project
how:
1. "View as" › "Sarah"; "Settings" › "Projects"
2. "View as" › "Dane"; "Settings" › "Roles & access" › "Who may do what"
3. Read the "Projects" group
expect: Sarah reads "Only Owners and Admins change these." and every switch is greyed. Under Projects: "Post an update to the client" (Designer: "Submits for approval — their own"; "Set under Projects › What waits for an Owner or an Admin"), "Complete a handover with checklist items still open" (Designer: Submits for approval — their own), "Reopen a completed project" and "Delete, restore or delete forever a project" (ticks for Owner and Admin only).
